title: Record policy-denied Skill actions in the audit chain
goal: Ensure policy-denied Skill proposals include their Skill identity and a failed observation linked by actionID, without claiming execution occurred.
context: M6 actionDenied events currently include toolID only and denied proposals append an observation in memory without emitting observationProduced. Skill denials therefore lose identity linkage in the event log.
forbidden_changes: Do not emit actionExecuted for a denied proposal.
Do not invoke SkillExecutionBoundary after policy denial.
Do not change policy decisions, capabilities, or cancellation behavior.
acceptance_criteria: actionDenied includes skillID for Skill proposals.
Denied proposals emit observationProduced with succeeded=false and the same actionID.
Skill denial observations have verified=false and never actionExecuted.
The goal is authoritatively aborted after denial.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If event assertions fail, preserve the original policy denial, include Skill identity on the denial, and emit only a failed observation—not an execution event.
